title: Collection Time vs Bar Time Statistics

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  'Avg Collection Delay (min)' as metric,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (received_at - timestamp))/60), 2) as value
FROM (
  SELECT received_at, timestamp FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon WHERE received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT received_at, timestamp FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo WHERE received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
) combined
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Max Collection Delay (min)' as metric,
  ROUND(MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (received_at - timestamp))/60), 2) as value
FROM (
  SELECT received_at, timestamp FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon WHERE received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT received_at, timestamp FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo WHERE received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
) combined
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Bars Collected On Time (<5min)' as metric,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (received_at - timestamp))/60 < 5) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as value
FROM (
  SELECT received_at, timestamp FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon WHERE received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT received_at, timestamp FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo WHERE received_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
) combined
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Latest Bar Time' as metric,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(timestamp)))/60 as value
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo
) combined
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Latest Collection Time' as metric,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(received_at)))/60 as value
FROM (
  SELECT received_at FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon
  UNION ALL
  SELECT received_at FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo
) combined
